verdict.rationale: GitLab ships an official CLI documented on its own docs site, plus a GitLab Duo CLI that brings agentic Duo Chat to the terminal. The GitLab CLI is also used in AI workflows, such as recording Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex sessions for the AI governance dashboard. Missing for 10: detailed command-level documentation of the CLI's capabilities in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI-native workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: GitLab Duo Chat is available in: The GitLab UI. A variety of IDEs. The GitLab Duo CLI.
Record Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex sessions with the GitLab CLI so they appear on the dashboard as ECAs.
